findings.evidenceJa: なさけない
findings.governingReading: He calls his sleepless state pathetic or shameful.
findings.explanation: A complaint about his sorry showing becomes a global judgment of his worth.

findings.highlight: take her to places she hasn’t been and play around
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで行かなかった場所、色々な遊び場に連れ回して楽しませる
findings.governingReading: His first priority is to drag her around many kinds of recreation spots she has never visited and see that she enjoys herself.
findings.explanation: The English loses both the range of entertainment venues and his comically forceful plan to haul Saber through them.

findings.highlight: I used it going against my principles, but it It was useless in the end.
findings.evidenceJa: まったく役には立たなかったが
findings.governingReading: The alarm clock proved no use at all.
findings.explanation: An unsupported claim that borrowing it violated his principles is left inside visibly duplicated revision debris.

findings.highlight: Saber is a girl. If we go to cute-looking stores, she’s bound to have fun.
findings.evidenceJa: ともかく可愛らしい店をハシゴしていけば楽しくないワケがない
findings.governingReading: He assumes that hopping from one cute shop to another cannot fail to be fun.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a categorical explanation about Saber’s gender that the source never states.

findings.evidenceJa: 可愛らしい店をハシゴしていけば
findings.governingReading: if they keep hopping from one cute shop to another
findings.explanation: The itinerary’s repeated progression from shop to shop disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m going to entertain her today until she gives up.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが音を上げるまで娯楽まみれにしてやろう
findings.governingReading: He will bury or drench Saber in amusement until she cries uncle.
findings.explanation: The aggressive comic excess of saturating her in entertainment is reduced to ordinary entertaining.

findings.highlight: Shirou cannot be concerned with Illyasviel.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィールに構っている余裕はありません
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no time or leeway to attend to Illyasviel.
findings.explanation: A tactical claim about available attention becomes a statement about emotional concern.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka tries to hide her laughter.
findings.evidenceJa: きしし、と笑いを抑える遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin suppresses a kishishi cackle.
findings.explanation: The translation removes the written laugh sound that gives her teasing a particular comic voice.

findings.highlight: caring for her has the opposite effect
findings.evidenceJa: 気を遣うのは逆効果だ
findings.governingReading: Being tactful or considerate about this only backfires.
findings.explanation: Social tact becomes caregiving, changing what Shirou thinks has failed.

findings.evidenceJa: きっちりかっちり、判りやすく言った方が
findings.governingReading: It is better to spell it out squarely and precisely so she can understand.
findings.explanation: The playful doubled emphasis on exact, unambiguous wording disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 専門的な略語
findings.governingReading: technical abbreviations
findings.explanation: Saber specifically misclassifies date as an abbreviation; the English broadens this to any specialist vocabulary and weakens the joke.

findings.evidenceJa: 別に専門的な単語じゃないぞ
findings.governingReading: It is not a technical term.
findings.explanation: Vocabulary is incorrectly treated as a singular count noun, leaving malformed English at the punch line.

findings.evidenceJa: ますます不思議そうに顔をしかめた
findings.governingReading: Her frown grows still more puzzled.
findings.explanation: Saber’s bafflement is recast as displeasure, distorting the emotional beat of her realization that Shirou sees her as a girl.

findings.evidenceJa: 逢い引き
findings.governingReading: a lovers’ tryst or clandestine romantic meeting
findings.explanation: The explicit romantic charge of Rin’s deliberately provocative definition is weakened into a neutral meeting.

findings.highlight: a chance for a man to appeal to a woman he likes
findings.evidenceJa: 男の子が好きな女の子にアピールするチャンス
findings.governingReading: a chance for a boy to make an appeal to a girl he likes
findings.explanation: Rin’s light, teasing boy-and-girl framing is aged into adult man-and-woman language.

findings.evidenceJa: 口だしするまでもない
findings.governingReading: There is no need for him to interject.
findings.explanation: A judgment that Rin’s explanation has already worked becomes self-restraint based on what he ought not do.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりに意味がありません
findings.governingReading: it is far too pointless
findings.explanation: The literal degree construction produces conspicuously non-English phrasing.

findings.highlight: I’ve already decided to spend today for you
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はセイバーの為に使うって決めた
findings.governingReading: He has decided to devote today to Saber.
findings.explanation: The benefactive construction is copied into an unnatural English collocation.

findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔で思案した
findings.governingReading: She deliberates with a troubled, difficult expression.
findings.explanation: The English replaces visible difficulty and conflict with generic seriousness.

findings.highlight: Or the stuff I thought about all night will go to waste.
findings.evidenceJa: そうでなきゃ一晩考え抜いたのがバカみたいだ
findings.governingReading: Otherwise he will look like a fool for having thought it through all night.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-mocking embarrassment becomes a utilitarian concern about wasting effort.

findings.evidenceJa: 深呼吸をした後
findings.governingReading: After taking a deep breath
findings.explanation: Saber’s deliberate regulating breath becomes a sigh, adding weariness or resignation.

findings.highlight: I get really angry about her following me because she’s my Servant. But I managed to succeed in getting Saber out. So I just have to take Saber to places without thinking too much about it
findings.evidenceJa: 後は細かいコトを考えず、セイバーを連れ回してやろうじゃないか
findings.governingReading: Now he will stop sweating the details and take Saber around.
findings.explanation: An unsupported claim that Shirou is angry about Saber following him is inserted between duplicate versions of the surrounding lines.

findings.highlight: it would be strange for you to be out walking
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと出歩く方がおかしい
findings.governingReading: It would be strange for a Master to go wandering about so readily or casually.
findings.explanation: The restriction is broadened from careless everyday roaming to being outside at all.

findings.evidenceJa: 無言で背後に控えている
findings.governingReading: She remains silently stationed behind him in attendance.
findings.explanation: Saber’s formal, watchful attendant posture is reduced to ordinary walking.

findings.highlight: I feel pressure from behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 背中にピリピリと威圧を感じる
findings.governingReading: He feels a prickling intimidation against his back.
findings.explanation: The bodily, electric quality of Saber’s pressure disappears.

findings.highlight: an old lady and a kid
findings.evidenceJa: 子供連れのおばあさん
findings.governingReading: an old woman accompanied by a child
findings.explanation: The English lists two passengers without preserving that the child is with the woman.

findings.highlight: the back end of the bus
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろの大きな座席
findings.governingReading: the large seat at the back
findings.explanation: The English turns the seat into a general area and drops the large rear bench that motivates sitting together.

findings.evidenceJa: 流れていく景色を挑むように見つめている
findings.governingReading: She stares at the passing scenery as if challenging it.
findings.explanation: The English removes Saber’s combative gaze, flattening the comic sign of how tense she is about the date.

findings.evidenceJa: その姿を盗み見て
findings.governingReading: Stealing a glance at her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s covert attention and embarrassment disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: あり得る筈のない非日常が混入している
findings.governingReading: An impossible piece of the extraordinary has intruded into his everyday life.
findings.explanation: A violation of the boundary between ordinary life and the impossible is reduced to the presence of something unusual.

findings.evidenceJa: 六面体パズル
findings.governingReading: a six-faced cube puzzle
findings.explanation: The English replaces the source’s generic description with a specific trademarked product.

findings.evidenceJa: 本格的に、手のつけられないぐらい緊張してきた
findings.governingReading: He is becoming seriously nervous, to a degree he cannot control.
findings.explanation: The translation omits that his nerves are getting beyond his ability to manage them.

findings.evidenceJa: どくん、と一際高く心臓が鳴る
findings.governingReading: His heart gives one exceptionally loud thud.
findings.explanation: The concrete loud beat is replaced by a generic startle idiom.

findings.highlight: No, Saber herself is the same. All that’s changed is the situation. No, Saber herself is the same. All that’s changed is the place. But still.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバー自身はいつも通りで、状況が今までと違うだけ
findings.governingReading: Saber herself is unchanged; only the situation differs from before.
findings.explanation: Two competing revisions are both printed, and the second wrongly narrows the changed circumstances to physical place.

findings.highlight: Her hair is like golden silk
findings.evidenceJa: 金砂のような髪
findings.governingReading: hair like gold dust or golden sand
findings.explanation: The granular glittering image is replaced with smooth silk.

findings.highlight: I was finally able to believe in Saber with everything I have
findings.evidenceJa: 後戻りできないところまでセイバーを信じるようになって
findings.governingReading: He has come to trust Saber past the point where he can turn back.
findings.explanation: Irreversible emotional commitment becomes a completed ability to believe with maximum effort.

findings.highlight: I can only do my best
findings.evidenceJa: もともと出来る事を全力でやるしか能がない
findings.governingReading: His only knack has always been throwing all his strength into whatever he can do.
findings.explanation: A characteristic self-assessment of his limited competence and all-or-nothing conduct becomes generic encouragement.

findings.evidenceJa: 笛のように息を吐いて
findings.governingReading: He lets out a whistle-like breath.
findings.explanation: The audible simile marking his attempt to steady himself disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 次は新都駅前
findings.governingReading: the next stop is in front of Shinto Station
findings.explanation: A distinct station-front stop or district is collapsed into the station itself.
